steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Power rule: d/dx(xⁿ) = nxⁿ⁻¹ for all real n

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Find the stationary points of y = x^3 - 3x^2 - 9x + 5 and determine their nature --- Solution: y' = 3x^2 - 6x - 9 = 3(x^2 - 2x - 3) = 3(x-3)(x+1) = 0 -> x = 3 or x = -1. y'' = 6x - 6. At x = 3: y'' = 12 > 0 -> minimum at (3, -22). At x = -1: y'' = -12 < 0 -> maximum at (-1, 10)

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Differentiate: xsqrt(x+2) using product rule | Find the equation of the normal to y = x^2 - 4x + 3 at x = 2 | A rectangular box with square base has volume 500 cm^3. Find minimum surface area

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of differentiation with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step. Key points review (5 min): Revisit the key points together, confirming understanding. Worked example (10 min): Model the example question: Find the stationary points of y = x^3 - 3x^2 - 9x + 5 and determine their nature. Solution: y' = 3x^2 - 6x - 9 = 3(x^2 - 2x - 3) = 3(x-3)(x+1) = 0 -> x = 3 or x = -1. y'' = 6x - 6. At x = 3: y'' = 12 > 0 -> minimum at (3, -22). At x = -1: y'' = -12 < 0 -> maximum at (-1, 10) Practice (10 min): Students attempt the practice questions independently; circulate and support. Plenary (5 min): Review answers and address misconceptions.
